review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner, self-review of regression design
review.decision: Address the independently reproduced release review findings before closing the candidate
review.notes: Reviewed the exact preceding PR head, the standalone read-only Codex review, and the actual call paths. Synthetic fixtures only. Review findings are independently obtained; this design record is authored here.

cases.description: Every unsurfaced report gets a bounded independent notice opportunity
cases.setup: Nine outstanding managed relay references and the real notice journal, fake desktop sink, fake clock.
cases.action: Scan twice with all nine still unclaimed, then re-scan under cooldown.
cases.expected: At most eight first notices per scan; ninth announced without waiting for earlier claims; prior history stays intact and no duplicate alerts.

cases.description: A due deferred report gets an ordinary check without renewing the native reservation
cases.setup: Persisted deferred managed report previously reserved and another before its due clock.
cases.action: Read both wake projections before and at the due point.
cases.expected: No early wake; at due it is ordinarily visible and its original native opportunity remains consumed.

cases.description: A qualifying same-thread Stop survives later unrelated turns
cases.setup: Synthetic different-home and exact-home end rows, including triage-ambiguous Stop and a later exact-home Stop.
cases.action: Build the real attention queue before and after inserting the later turn end.
cases.expected: An earlier matching end in the five-minute window still prioritizes the report. Unrelated or outside-window ends confer no priority.
